projects.summary: A JICA technical cooperation project with Japan's NIID (now part of JIHS) as the cooperating institution. It strengthened NIHE's laboratory network, biosafety and BSL-3 capacity, and piloted training in Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia.
projects.note: Carried out by NIID, which merged into JIHS in 2025.

projects.institutes: University of Nebraska Medical Center; Global Center for Health Security; NETEC
projects.title: JIHS–UNMC memorandum on high-consequence infectious disease preparedness
projects.summary: A memorandum signed in June 2025 that renews and extends to JIHS a partnership dating from 2016, covering biocontainment, clinical research networks and training exercises.
projects.note: The partnership began in 2016 with NCGM.

projects.institutes: National Institute of Public Health (NIOPH), Lao PDR
projects.title: NCGM–Lao National Institute of Public Health joint research and advisory support
projects.summary: NCGM's Bureau of International Health Cooperation (now JIHS) carries out joint research with Lao PDR's National Institute of Public Health, sends advisors, and acts as secretariat for related Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW) projects.
projects.note: Archived NCGM page.

projects.institutes: Health Bureau, Ministry of Health and Sports, Myanmar
projects.title: NCGM–Myanmar Ministry of Health MoU
projects.summary: An MoU signed in April 2014 for joint research, mainly through JICA projects.
projects.note: Archived NCGM page.

projects.institutes: Tribhuvan University Institute of Medicine
projects.title: NCGM–Tribhuvan University Institute of Medicine MoU
projects.summary: An MoU signed in 2013 for collaborative research and human resource development.
projects.note: Archived NCGM page.

projects.institutes: Bach Mai Hospital; Cho Ray Hospital
projects.title: NCGM overseas base and MoUs with Bach Mai and Cho Ray hospitals
projects.summary: NCGM has run an overseas base at Bach Mai Hospital since 2005 and holds MoUs with Bach Mai and Cho Ray hospitals (Cho Ray signed 2014) covering research, training and hospital management.
projects.note: Archived NCGM page. JICA cooperation dates from 1995.

projects.institutes: National Maternal and Child Health Centre, Cambodia
projects.title: NCGM–Cambodia National Maternal and Child Health Centre MoU
projects.summary: An MoU covering technical support, research and training, building on about 20 years of expert dispatch to the centre.
projects.note: Archived NCGM page.

projects.institutes: Africa CDC
projects.title: EU for health security in Africa: ECDC for Africa CDC
projects.summary: EU-funded (EUR 9 million to ECDC plus EUR 1 million to Africa CDC) four-year capacity project in which ECDC supports Africa CDC on preparedness and emergency operations, harmonised surveillance and epidemic intelligence, and public health workforce development.
projects.note: Distinct from the separate Africa CDC–ECDC MoU. Funded by DG DEVCO/INTPA; agreement concluded Oct 2020, effective 1 Jan 2021. Later described as a five-year project that concluded in April 2025 (ECDC experts also deployed via EU Health Task Force); succeeded by an MoU (2026) and a Team Europe AMR/One Health initiative.

projects.institutes: African Union Commission / Africa CDC
projects.title: US–African Union memorandum of cooperation to establish Africa CDC
projects.summary: 2015 memorandum under which US CDC provided technical expertise and planning support to create Africa CDC, including two long-term US CDC advisors seconded to the AU and fellowships for 10 African epidemiologists.

projects.institutes: Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI)
projects.title: China CDC – EPHI memorandum of understanding
projects.summary: MoU signed by video link in August 2022 covering infectious disease prevention and control, maternal and child nutrition, and laboratory testing capacity, with interest in China's malaria-elimination experience.

projects.institutes: Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI); Africa CDC; Armauer Hansen Research Institute
projects.title: China CDC delegation visit to EPHI and Africa CDC for joint research planning
projects.summary: September 2025 China CDC delegation visit assessing EPHI, AHRI and Africa CDC capacities on HIV, hepatitis and malaria testing and surveillance, to prepare joint China–Africa research projects in Ethiopia.

projects.institutes: Zambia National Public Health Institute (ZNPHI)
projects.title: China CDC – ZNPHI memorandum of understanding
projects.summary: MoU signed in July 2019 between China CDC and Zambia's national public health institute focusing on public health capacity building, health informatics and laboratory strengthening.

projects.institutes: International Vaccine Institute (IVI, Seoul)
projects.title: ZNPHI – International Vaccine Institute MoU on vaccine manufacturing
projects.summary: MoU signed in Lusaka in September 2025 to build Zambia's capacity across the vaccine and therapeutics value chain, from pre-clinical development to manufacturing and market access.
projects.note: IVI is an international organisation headquartered in South Korea, not a national public health institute.

projects.institutes: National Public Health Agency of Sierra Leone (NPHA); Ministry of Health Sierra Leone; Africa CDC
projects.title: China CDC – NPHA Sierra Leone seminar on priority infectious diseases and lab capacity
projects.summary: Joint seminar in Freetown (November 2025) on malaria, Lassa fever and HIV control, surveillance and laboratory networks, agreeing priorities on sustainable laboratory systems and staff training.
projects.note: Distinct from the earlier BSL-3 lab and China–UK capacity entries; Ethiopia stands for Africa CDC participation.

projects.institutes: Rwanda Biomedical Centre (RBC)
projects.title: TRIBE-HUB – Transforming Rwanda's Biomedical Centre into an excellence hub for national and regional public health
projects.summary: EU-funded (about EUR 3.9 million) Support to African Public Health Institutes project strengthening RBC as Rwanda's NPHI, its digital health capacity and its links with European and African public health institutes.

projects.institutes: Public Health Institute of Malawi (PHIM); Ministry of Health Malawi
projects.title: Support to the Public Health Institute of Malawi (Team Europe NPHI initiative)
projects.summary: Four-year EUR 4.6 million EU/BMZ co-financed project launched June 2025 to strengthen PHIM and its collaboration with African and European national public health institutes.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health and Child Care Zimbabwe; WHO
projects.title: EU support to establish Zimbabwe's first National Public Health Institute
projects.summary: EUR 4.2 million four-year EU investment, implemented with WHO, to set up Zimbabwe's NPHI and connect it with African and European public health institutes that run similar models.
projects.note: Start year not stated on the page.

projects.actor: European Commission with 12 EU Member States
projects.institutes: Africa CDC; IANPHI; WHO; African NPHIs
projects.title: Team Europe Initiative: Strengthening Public Health Institutes in Africa (TEI PHI)
projects.summary: Launched March 2024 by the European Commission, 12 EU Member States and Africa CDC to strengthen African NPHIs' institutional capacity, regional collaboration and workforce, including linking European and African public health institutes; a EUR 50 million regional programme is implemented by Belgium, France, Germany, Sweden and WHO.
projects.note: Partner list = countries the source names as well supported by European NPHI-related support; Ethiopia = Africa CDC. Country projects (e.g. Rwanda, Malawi, Zimbabwe, Burundi, Guinea/DRC) are listed separately.

projects.actor: Institut de Veille Sanitaire (InVS, now Santé publique France)
projects.institutes: Institut National d'Hygiène (INH), Morocco
projects.title: EU twinning to modernise Morocco's Institut National d'Hygiène
projects.summary: EU-funded twinning under the EU–Morocco Association Agreement, launched January 2009, in which InVS and other French bodies (AFNOR, CHU de Rouen, CNEH, ADETEF) helped Morocco's INH meet international public health and health-security standards.
projects.note: EU budget about MAD 14 million; actions planned over 2008–2010.

projects.institutes: West African Health Organisation (WAHO); ECOWAS Regional Centre for Surveillance and Disease Control (RCSDC); national public health institutes of priority countries
projects.title: Support to the Regional Centre for Surveillance and Disease Control in the ECOWAS zone
projects.summary: Three-year EU-funded project implemented by GIZ within the BMZ Regional Programme Support to Pandemic Prevention in the ECOWAS Region, strengthening WAHO's RCSDC and surveillance (incl. SORMAS) with priority countries Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone and Togo.
projects.note: Launch year inferred (page refers to 2019 as the past year); RCSDC is in Abuja, WAHO HQ in Bobo-Dioulasso.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health and Population (MoHP) Egypt; Central Public Health Laboratories
projects.title: International Emerging Infections Program (IEIP) Egypt
projects.summary: CDC–MoHP programme established in 2005 in Damanhur to strengthen disease surveillance, laboratory diagnostics, data management and training, intended as a model for expansion across the Nile Delta and to support Egypt's role as an Africa CDC regional centre.

projects.actor: Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI) with Africa CDC
projects.institutes: NPHIs / public health agencies of Comoros, Madagascar, Rwanda (RBC), Somalia, South Sudan and Tanzania
projects.title: Africa CDC NPHI Peer-to-Peer Learning Programme hosted by EPHI
projects.summary: EPHI hosted directors-general and delegates from six Eastern African member states for a week of peer learning on surveillance, emergency preparedness, laboratory systems, research, workforce and health information, under Africa CDC's NPHI peer-to-peer programme.
projects.note: Comoros also participated (not in atlas). Held 25 Sep–1 Oct 2023.

projects.institutes: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC); UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA)
projects.title: ZNPHI study visit to NCDC Nigeria and joint EOC simulation exercise
projects.summary: ZNPHI's director-general led a March 2022 delegation, accompanied by UKHSA, to NCDC to observe a multi-state emergency operations centre simulation exercise and discuss a peer-to-peer exchange programme between the two institutes.

projects.institutes: Africa CDC; NCDC Nigeria; US CDC; IANPHI; NPHIs and ministries of 13 ECOWAS countries
projects.title: West Africa NPHI acceleration workshop (WAHO, Africa CDC, NCDC, US CDC, IANPHI)
projects.summary: March 2024 workshop in Abuja where established, recent and nascent West African NPHIs shared lessons and drafted stage-appropriate action plans for establishing or strengthening their institutes, with requested partner support.
projects.note: Cabo Verde also participated (not in atlas). Burkina Faso also participated; it is WAHO's seat.

projects.institutes: South Sudan Ministry of Health and line ministries; Africa CDC
projects.title: Africa CDC AMR surveillance peer-to-peer exchange: South Sudan at NICD
projects.summary: Five-day 2025 visit, organised by Africa CDC, in which NICD's AMR and healthcare-associated infections centre (CHARM) shared laboratory, susceptibility testing, quality assurance and data management practice with a South Sudanese delegation to strengthen its national AMR surveillance.
projects.note: Ethiopia stands for Africa CDC as organiser.

projects.actor: Africa CDC Southern Africa Regional Collaborating Centre with ZNPHI
projects.institutes: Africa CDC; US CDC; IANPHI; NPHIs of Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique (INS), Namibia, South Africa (NICD) and Zimbabwe
projects.title: Southern Africa summit on establishing and strengthening NPHIs
projects.summary: Three-day September 2019 meeting in Livingstone where Southern African NPHIs held peer exchanges on core functions, lessons and strategies, and agreed that exchange visits and peer mentorship are critical to NPHI development.

projects.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
projects.institutes: Theodor Bilharz Research Institute; Ain Shams University; Ministry of Health and Population Egypt; Academy of Scientific Research and Technology
projects.title: China–Egypt collaborative research on schistosomiasis and other vector-borne tropical diseases
projects.summary: NSFC-funded joint research project; an August 2024 China CDC delegation visit held a progress meeting and discussed schistosomiasis and malaria control, research and training, aiming at a longer-term China–Africa tropical disease cooperation platform.
projects.note: Project start year not stated; 2024 is the visit year.

projects.institutes: Africa CDC (Wu Lien-teh Laboratory); trainees from 16 African countries
projects.title: China CDC – Africa CDC overseas laboratory technology training programme
projects.summary: Three-week programme opened 3 November 2025 at Africa CDC headquarters training 30 participants from 16 countries in pathogen detection, sequencing and bioinformatics, AMR surveillance and lab quality management.
projects.note: A specific activity under the broader China CDC–Africa CDC cooperation (listed separately). Only Zambia is named among the 16 trainee countries.

projects.institutes: Health professionals from African ministries and public health agencies
projects.title: Training course on emerging and re-emerging infectious disease control for Africa
projects.summary: Two-week foreign-aid course (September 2025) sponsored by China's Ministry of Commerce and run by China CDC for 22 African health professionals on surveillance, laboratory testing, outbreak control and emergency response.

projects.institutes: Africa CDC (incl. Central Africa Regional Coordinating Centre, Libreville); Ministry of Health Gabon
projects.title: Africa CDC–ECDC antimicrobial stewardship training in Gabon
projects.summary: September 2025 national One Health antimicrobial stewardship training in Lambaréné, co-organised by Africa CDC, ECDC and Gabon's Ministry of Health with a Gabon-adapted curriculum, under the AMR work package of the Africa CDC–ECDC partnership project.

projects.institutes: Africa CDC; African Society for Laboratory Medicine (ASLM); EDCTP; Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs; ICARS
projects.title: Team Europe Initiative action: Fighting AMR and strengthening the One Health workforce in Africa
projects.summary: Team Europe action with Africa CDC, launched in Addis Ababa in May 2026 after a Danish-funded inception phase, in which ECDC, EDCTP and ASLM support AMR control and One Health workforce development in Africa.
projects.note: A March 2026 report says a new five-year ECDC–Africa CDC initiative under this TEI starts May 2026 (with EFSA).

projects.actor: Africa CDC with African Society for Laboratory Medicine (ASLM)
projects.institutes: European Union (Team Europe Initiative on Sustainable Health Security); Ethiopian Public Health Institute and national AMR reference laboratories
projects.title: ARILAC – Advancing Regional Integrated Laboratory Capacity for AMR Control
projects.summary: Four-year EU-supported One Health laboratory initiative launched May 2026 to strengthen integrated laboratory-based AMR surveillance and lab capacity in eight AU member states.
projects.note: Ethiopia is also a target country. Belgium = EU (Brussels) as funder.

projects.institutes: Rwanda Biomedical Centre (RBC); Africa CDC
projects.title: Africa CDC–ECDC R data-analysis training for Rwanda Biomedical Centre experts
projects.summary: May 2025 hands-on R training for 15 RBC surveillance experts using local datasets, delivered with Africa CDC under the Africa CDC–ECDC partnership project as a pilot for country-specific trainings in other AU member states.

projects.actor: National Public Health Agency of Sierra Leone (NPHA) (host)
projects.institutes: Ministry of Health Mozambique (National Directorate of Public Health); WHO country office Sierra Leone
projects.title: Mozambique Ministry of Health South–South learning visit to Sierra Leone
projects.summary: March 2024 WHO-facilitated exchange in which a Mozambican delegation led by the National Director of Public Health learned from NPHA and Sierra Leone's ministry about public health emergency management, surveillance and emergency operations centres.

projects.institutes: National public health institutes of North African AU member states
projects.title: Africa CDC peer-to-peer and twinning programme between North African NPHIs
projects.summary: Africa CDC programme, financed by the World Bank Africa CDC Support Program (P178633), to establish and strengthen NPHIs in North Africa, including support for peer-to-peer learning and twinning between NPHIs in the region.
projects.note: Source is a 2023 consultant ToR; implementation status not confirmed. Sahrawi Republic listed as member state (mapped to W. Sahara). An earlier equivalent for other regions was AfDB-funded.

projects.actor: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC)
projects.institutes: Nagasaki University; JICA
projects.title: NCDC – Nagasaki University partnership under JICA PREPARE
projects.summary: Nagasaki University has hosted long-term NCDC trainees through JICA's PREPARE programme on infectious disease countermeasures and research; a January 2025 visit by NCDC's director-general agreed to deepen ties via a future JICA technical cooperation project.
projects.note: Nagasaki University is an academic partner, not an NPHI. Start year of trainee placements not stated.

projects.actor: Lithuanian consortium led by Vilnius University Hospital Santaros Klinikos (with National Public Health Surveillance Laboratory, Health Emergency Situations Centre, National Blood Center, CPVA)
projects.institutes: L. Sakvarelidze National Center for Disease Control and Public Health (NCDC); Ministry of IDPs, Labour, Health and Social Affairs of Georgia
projects.title: EU Twinning: Enhance national disease surveillance in Georgia through improved epidemiological and molecular (genomic) surveillance
projects.summary: Lithuanian-led EU Twinning (EUR 1.2 million) strengthening NCDC Georgia's epidemiological and genomic surveillance in line with EU rules under the Association Agreement.
projects.note: CPVA page gives 2024–2025; Lithuanian development cooperation map (ltaid.urm.lt) gives 2024–2026 (24+3 months).

projects.actor: Lithuanian consortium (National Blood Centre, Vilnius University, National Public Health Surveillance Laboratory) with Sanquin (Netherlands)
projects.institutes: National Center for Disease Control and Public Health (NCDC); Ministry of IDPs, Labour, Health and Social Affairs of Georgia
projects.title: EU Twinning: Strengthening Blood Safety System in Georgia
projects.summary: EU Twinning launched in September 2020 that revised Georgia's blood-safety legal framework, assessed blood banks and supported reorganising transfusion services and lab capacity with NCDC Georgia.
projects.note: Launched Sept 2020 (24 months per ltaid.urm.lt Lithuanian project map, which lists Lithuania as lead); end year inferred. EEAS launch article names Sanquin as a partner.

projects.institutes: Public Health Institution of Turkey (Ministry of Health); Ghent University; Amsterdam UMC
projects.title: ESPrIT – Strengthening the occupational health expertise and scientific capacity of the Public Health Institution of Turkey
projects.summary: Horizon 2020 Twinning that used training, mentoring and staff exchanges to build PHIT's research capacity on occupational diseases and national data collection.
projects.note: Coordinator formally the Turkish Ministry of Health; TNO is the main EU partner. Horizon 2020 twinning, not the EU institutional Twinning instrument.

projects.institutes: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
projects.title: UKHSA–ECDC Memorandum of Understanding
projects.summary: MoU signed on 1 December 2021 by Jenny Harries and Andrea Ammon to cooperate on epidemic intelligence, risk assessment, lab capacity for emerging threats, AMR and healthcare-associated infections.
projects.note: No end date published. Followed by a data sharing agreement in early 2025 giving UKHSA EpiPulse access (UK the first third country to sign one with ECDC), per UKHSA board paper AB-25-039.

projects.institutes: National partners in nine countries/territories; WHO EMRO sequencing hubs (Oman, Abu Dhabi, Morocco); Africa CDC; CARPHA
projects.title: New Variant Assessment Platform (NVAP) – international genomic surveillance partnerships
projects.summary: Set up by PHE in 2021 and continued by UKHSA, NVAP provides sequencing reagents, training in bioinformatics and variant risk assessment, and scientific exchanges to partner countries and regional bodies.
projects.note: As of May 2022, also Cayman Islands and Singapore (not in atlas). Guidance page last updated 2026.

projects.institutes: National Center for Disease Control and Public Health (NCDC); Lugar Center for Public Health Research
projects.title: CDC–Georgia NCDC partnership
projects.summary: Long-standing CDC collaboration with Georgia's NCDC since 1995 on field epidemiology training, the Lugar Center lab (AMR EQA, regional genomic hub), emergency management, hepatitis C elimination and workforce strategy.
projects.note: Georgia designated a US Intensive Support Partner Country for Health Security in 2023.

projects.institutes: Agence Nationale de Sécurité Sanitaire (ANSS); Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP)
projects.title: CDC support to Guinea's ANSS
projects.summary: Since opening an office in 2015, CDC has helped ANSS build a multitiered surveillance and response structure (rapid response teams, EOCs, 7-1-7 approach with DHIS2) and supports FETP and INSP lab strengthening.

projects.institutes: Institute of Epidemiology, Disease Control and Research (IEDCR); icddr,b
projects.title: CDC–IEDCR partnership in Bangladesh
projects.summary: CDC has partnered with IEDCR since the 2001 Nipah outbreak on outbreak response, influenza and priority-pathogen surveillance, FETP, lab and genomic capacity, and the national public health EOC.

projects.institutes: National Institute of Health (NIH) Islamabad
projects.title: CDC–Pakistan NIH cooperation (surveillance, FELTP, GLLP)
projects.summary: Under a cooperative agreement with Pakistan's NIH, CDC supported influenza sentinel surveillance from 2004, FELTP from 2006 (handed to government in 2021) and the Global Laboratory Leadership Programme from 2019.
projects.note: The general CDC NPHI development entry already lists Pakistan; this entry covers the specific surveillance/training cooperation.

projects.institutes: Uganda National Institute of Public Health (UNIPH); Ministry of Health PHEOC
projects.title: CDC–UNIPH collaboration (FETP, Laboratory Leadership Program, PHEOC)
projects.summary: CDC supported Uganda's PHEOC (2013), FETP (2015) and launched the Laboratory Leadership Program with UNIPH to strengthen lab management and leadership.

projects.institutes: Zambia National Public Health Institute (ZNPHI); Zambia National Public Health Reference Laboratory
projects.title: CDC funding for ZNPHI genomic sequencing capacity
projects.summary: During a November 2023 high-level visit, CDC confirmed US$2.5 million to expand genomic sequencing at Zambia's national public health reference lab for national and regional use.
projects.note: Zambia is also in the general CDC NPHI support entries.

projects.institutes: Chief State Sanitary Doctor of Ukraine / Ministry of Health of Ukraine
projects.title: Ukraine–Poland agreement on cooperation in public health (border exercises, epidemiological data exchange)
projects.summary: December 2025 agreement between the two chief sanitary officers on IHR implementation, infectious-disease data exchange, joint border-region preparedness, training and alignment with EU standards, including lab diagnostics and AMR.
projects.note: Signed under the 28 March 2024 MoU between the two health ministries. NPHIs (PHC Ukraine, NIZP PZH-PIB) are not named as parties.

projects.actor: France–Netherlands twinning consortium (French Ministry of Health lead)
projects.institutes: Agence Nationale de Contrôle Sanitaire et Environnemental des Produits (ANCSEP)
projects.title: EU Twinning: strengthening control of health and environmental risks (ANCSEP, Tunisia)
projects.summary: EUR 1 million EU Twinning (Sept 2015–Sept 2017) under the PACS programme helping Tunisia's ANCSEP improve health and environmental risk assessment and management, including legislative alignment.
projects.note: Project newsletter (EHESP site) cites ANSES, ANSM, EFSA and RIVM; exact member-state implementing bodies not confirmed. Lead institution assumed French.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health of Turkey; Public Health Institution of Turkey; provincial Public Health Directorates
projects.title: EU Twinning TR08-EN-05: Emergency case management and risk analysis in drinking water for the protection of public health in Turkey
projects.summary: Italian-led EU Twinning (2012–2013) with ISS building the Turkish health ministry's capacity for drinking-water risk assessment, early warning and emergency management in line with the EU Drinking Water Directive.
projects.note: Italy listed as leader in Turkish EU Ministry twinning list; ISS named as the Italian party (lead role inferred).

projects.actor: International Office for Water (OIEau) for the French Ministry of Social Affairs and Health
projects.institutes: Public Health Institution of Turkey (THSK)
projects.title: EU Twinning TR-10-IB-EN-02: Alignment in bathing water monitoring (Turkey)
projects.summary: French-led EU Twinning with an Italian junior partner, started January 2013, training about 150 Public Health Institution of Turkey staff in bathing-water quality monitoring and management under EU rules.
projects.note: End year inferred from the initial two-year duration. Beneficiary is Turkey's NPHI; the provider is not an NPHI.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health of Serbia; national reference laboratories; Institute of Public Health of Serbia 'Dr Milan Jovanović Batut'
projects.title: EU Twinning Light: Improving microbiology diagnostic system quality for communicable disease surveillance in Serbia
projects.summary: Italian–Serbian Twinning Light in which ISS-led experts carried out a gap assessment (Sept–Dec 2017) of Serbia's microbiology laboratory system against EU surveillance standards and the acquis.
projects.note: Twinning Light status and March 2018 completion come from the Serbia twinning fiche SR 20 IPA HE 01 22 (fm.gov.lv/lv/media/12410/download). The Batut institute's participation is assumed, not confirmed.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health of Vietnam; National Influenza Centers (Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City)
projects.title: CDC–Vietnam health security partnership
projects.summary: CDC has worked in Vietnam since 1998, supporting influenza surveillance (from 2005), FETP (from 2007, ~1,400 trained), lab accreditation, genome sequencing, AMR detection and lab leadership training with the Ministry of Health.
projects.note: Partner is the Ministry of Health rather than a single NPHI; see also IANPHI–CDC Vietnam NPHI creation entry.

projects.institutes: Kenya National Public Health Institute (KNPHI); Ministry of Health
projects.title: CDC and IANPHI support for establishing the Kenya National Public Health Institute
projects.summary: CDC sponsored a 2020 Nairobi planning workshop with IANPHI and hosted a Kenyan delegation in 2024 ahead of KNPHI's operational launch in May 2025, which took over the PHEOC, surveillance, port health and FELTP from the ministry.
projects.note: KNPHI established by Legal Notice No. 14 of 18 Jan 2022. Status is completed for the establishment phase; the wider CDC–Kenya partnership continues.

projects.institutes: Communicable Diseases Agency (CDA), Singapore
projects.title: UKHSA–Singapore Communicable Diseases Agency Memorandum of Understanding
projects.summary: MoU signed in late 2024 between UKHSA and Singapore's new Communicable Diseases Agency on health security cooperation.
projects.note: Partner country is Singapore, which is not in the world-atlas 110m map. Source is a UKHSA board paper on global health activities (2025).

projects.institutes: Africa CDC (Addis Ababa)
projects.title: UKHSA support to Africa CDC (staff secondment, African Volunteers Health Corps, outbreak response)
projects.summary: UKHSA seconds a staff member to the Africa CDC Director General's office and supports the African Volunteers Health Corps, continental outbreak response and IHR-SP regional work. The UK and Africa CDC held their first high-level health dialogue in November 2025.
projects.note: Start year is the reporting year 2024/25. Ethiopia stands in for Africa CDC headquarters. No UKHSA–Africa CDC MoU was found. Dialogue communiqué: gov.uk, 25 Nov 2025.

projects.institutes: US CDC; Australian CDC; Public Health Agency of Canada; New Zealand public health agency
projects.title: Five-nation public health institute exchanges on data sharing, digitalisation and AI
projects.summary: UKHSA held regular meetings in 2024/25 with the public health institutes of the US, Australia, Canada and New Zealand on data sharing, digitalisation and artificial intelligence.
projects.note: Partner institute names are inferred; the source says only 'Public Health Institutes of the US, Australia, Canada and New Zealand'.

projects.institutes: Santé publique France
projects.title: UKHSA mass-gatherings support to Santé publique France for Paris 2024
projects.summary: UKHSA advised Santé publique France on mass-gathering health protection for the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games.

projects.institutes: National Institute for Communicable Diseases (NICD)
projects.title: UKHSA support to South Africa's NICD for the mpox response
projects.summary: In 2024 UKHSA gave technical support to South Africa's NICD for its mpox outbreak response.
projects.note: Distinct from the older HPA–NICD north/south collaboration.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health; Angolan National AIDS Institute; National AIDS Program
projects.title: CDC Angola country office
projects.summary: CDC's Angola office (opened 2002) supports the Ministry of Health on workforce development, laboratory systems, HIV/TB (PEPFAR) and outbreak response, including strengthening the National AIDS Institute's laboratory systems.
projects.note: Page last updated Dec 2025, reviewed Mar 2026. CDC office closed 1 Oct 2026 (Politico via Becker's: https://www.beckershospitalreview.com/quality/cdc-closes-2-offices-in-africa-as-trump-ties-health-aid-to-deals-politico/).

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health; Ministry of Local Government and Traditional Affairs; Botswana Public Health Institute (in establishment, with IANPHI); Botswana FETP
projects.title: CDC Botswana country office
projects.summary: Since 1995 CDC has supported Botswana's Ministry of Health on HIV/TB, surveillance, lab accreditation and FETP, and works with IANPHI and the MOH to establish the Botswana Public Health Institute.

projects.institutes: Federal Ministry of Health; Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI); Ethiopia Field Epidemiology and Laboratory Training Program (EFELTP); regional health bureaus
projects.title: CDC Ethiopia – FMOH and EPHI collaboration
projects.summary: Since 2001 CDC has worked with Ethiopia's FMOH and EPHI on laboratory strengthening, surveillance, emergency operations centres and the EFELTP (launched 2009), plus PEPFAR HIV/TB and immunization work.

projects.institutes: Federal Ministry of Health; Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC); Nigeria FELTP; state ministries of health
projects.title: CDC Nigeria – support to NCDC and FMOH
projects.summary: CDC's Nigeria office (since 2001) supports NCDC and the health ministry with surveillance, laboratory accreditation, the FELTP (1,600+ graduates) and emergency response, alongside PEPFAR, malaria and immunization programmes.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health
projects.title: CDC Brazil country office
projects.summary: CDC opened an office in Brazil in 2003 to work with the Ministry of Health on HIV/AIDS, later also on epidemiologic surveillance, laboratory capacity and outbreak investigation.
projects.note: CDC page last updated 2014; current status not confirmed.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health; Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP); Central Reference Laboratory; National AMR reference laboratory; Burkina Faso FETP (with AFENET)
projects.title: CDC Burkina Faso – support to INSP
projects.summary: CDC has collaborated with Burkina Faso's MOH since 1991 (country office 2016), supporting the national public health institute INSP (est. 2018), reference labs incl. AMR, FETP, surveillance and One Health.
projects.note: Country office established 2016.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health; National Institute of Public Health (NIPH) incl. National Reference Medical Laboratory; National Center for Parasitology, Entomology and Malaria; National Center for HIV/AIDS, Dermatology and STD; Institut Pasteur du Cambodge; Cambodia FETP
projects.title: CDC Cambodia – MOH and NIPH collaboration
projects.summary: CDC Cambodia (est. 2002) works with the MOH and NIPH on surveillance, laboratory systems and the FETP (2011), plus HIV, malaria, influenza/H5N1 and One Health coordination.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Public Health; National Public Health Laboratory; Cameroon FETP (CAFETP); Centre for Research in Infectious Diseases (CRID); Public Health Emergency Operations Center
projects.title: CDC Cameroon country office
projects.summary: CDC has supported Cameroon since 1998 (office 2004), working with the Ministry of Public Health on surveillance, the national public health lab, emergency management (PHEOC), the CAFETP, HIV/TB, malaria and immunization.
projects.note: Country office established 2004.

projects.institutes: Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC); Chinese Field Epidemiology Training Program (CFETP); provincial and local CDCs
projects.title: CDC China – collaboration with China CDC
projects.summary: CDC has a Beijing country office since 2003 and works chiefly with China CDC on field epidemiology training (CFETP), influenza surveillance and pandemic preparedness, One Health and outbreak response (7-1-7).
projects.note: Page says partners in China for over 40 years.

projects.summary: Regional network founded in 2001 under a health-ministerial MoU linking six Mekong countries for cross-border surveillance, outbreak investigation and response, information sharing and capacity building; secretariat c/o Thailand's DDC.
projects.note: Member of CORDS.

projects.institutes: ANLIS Malbrán; INLASA; ISP Chile; INS Colombia; INSPI Ecuador; LACIMET Paraguay; INS Peru; DLSP Uruguay; INH Rafael Rangel
projects.title: RINS/UNASUR – Network of National Institutes of Health of South America
projects.summary: Network of ten South American national health institutes created in 2010 under the UNASUR Health Council, using structuring cooperation for exchange, training, institutional strengthening and joint projects, including joint work with RINSP/CPLP on social determinants.
projects.note: UNASUR has since largely dissolved; current activity unclear.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health Cambodia; Thailand International Cooperation Agency (TICA); border provincial health offices
projects.title: Cambodia–Thailand health development cooperation programme (2022–2024)
projects.summary: DDC coordinated the second bilateral health development cooperation programme with Cambodia, alongside cross-border COVID-19 support (e.g. emergency care at Koh Kong Hospital) and multilingual risk communication.

projects.institutes: Thailand–US CDC Collaboration; ministries of health of Cambodia, Lao PDR and Malaysia
projects.title: Multi-country emergency operations project (DGHP-iEOC Phase IV, TCLM)
projects.summary: DDC-led multi-country project with US CDC support strengthening emergency operations centres in Thailand, Cambodia, Lao PDR and Malaysia, with tabletop exercises among ASEAN countries.

projects.institutes: UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA)
projects.title: CARPHA – UKHSA memorandum of understanding
projects.summary: MoU for an equal partnership on outbreak response, lab and workforce capacity, genomic surveillance, AMR, NCDs and healthy tourism, preceded by UKHSA secondments in surveillance and field epidemiology in 2023.
projects.note: Also covers UK Overseas Territories that are CARPHA members (Anguilla, Bermuda, BVI, Cayman, Montserrat).

projects.institutes: US National Cancer Institute; Harvard School of Public Health; Universidad Hispanoamericana; Instituto de Cancerología (Guatemala); Instituto Nacional de Cancerología (Colombia)
projects.title: Regional Center of Excellence in chronic disease research (planning)
projects.summary: INSP-led planning of a regional centre of excellence for cancer and diabetes research with the US NCI and Central/South American cancer institutes, including a joint mortality-database study.
projects.note: Described in 2016 bulletin as two-year planning period.

projects.institutes: National public health laboratories of Fiji, Solomon Islands, Vanuatu and Kiribati
projects.title: eLABorate – laboratory accuracy and biosafety for outbreak response (DFAT Strategic Partnership)
projects.summary: VIDRL-led work area of the Doherty–DFAT Strategic Partnership (2024–2027) training Pacific national labs to expand molecular and serological testing with quality assurance and management.
projects.type: Project (DFAT Partnerships for a Healthy Region)
projects.note: Also Kiribati (not in atlas).

projects.actor: Doherty Institute (VIDRL / WHO CC for Viral Hepatitis)
projects.institutes: Ministries of health of Vanuatu, Solomon Islands, Cambodia and Fiji
projects.title: HiT3 – Hepatitis B integration into Triple Elimination
projects.summary: Technical support under the Doherty–DFAT Strategic Partnership to integrate hepatitis B into triple-elimination programmes for mother-to-child transmission of HIV, syphilis and hepatitis B.
projects.type: Project (DFAT Partnerships for a Healthy Region)

projects.institutes: Doherty Institute (MDU PHL, VIDRL, WHO CC for AMR); Australia DFAT; Pacific Community (SPC); WHO
projects.title: Fiji Pathogen Genomics Laboratory
projects.summary: Fiji CDC launched its national pathogen genomics lab in Suva in May 2025 with support from the Doherty Institute's public health labs, DFAT, SPC and WHO (sequencing equipment, mentorship and training).
projects.note: WHO provided WGS equipment in 2023; launch 7 May 2025.

projects.actor: National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), India
projects.institutes: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
projects.title: NCDC – US CDC Global Disease Detection Centre India
projects.summary: MoU signed in 2010 to establish a Global Disease Detection Centre at NCDC (operational 2011) strengthening epidemic surveillance and response, public health laboratories and workforce for pandemic influenza and emerging diseases.
projects.note: MoU signed 6 Nov 2010.

projects.institutes: Pan American Health Organization (PAHO); Sinergium Biotech; Agencia I+D+i
projects.title: ANLIS–PAHO technical cooperation agreement on vaccine development and production
projects.summary: Four-party technical cooperation agreement to strengthen capacity to develop and produce vaccines and health technologies in Argentina and the Americas, supporting the WHO mRNA technology-transfer hub.
projects.note: PAHO seat country used.

projects.institutes: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (zoonotic and emerging infectious diseases group)
projects.title: INS Colombia – US CDC joint Zika research
projects.summary: INS and a US CDC expert delegation prioritised five joint Zika studies and diagnostic technology transfer under a presidential-level bilateral agreement, drafting a joint work plan.
projects.note: Undated on page; Zika epidemic period.

projects.institutes: US Department of State; STRIDES programme
projects.title: INS Colombia – US health security cooperation (STRIDES)
projects.summary: US-funded health security cooperation with INS focusing on zoonotic threats, AMR, laboratory strengthening and surveillance/communication systems, continued from 2025 via the STRIDES implementing programme.

projects.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
projects.institutes: Department of Health, Philippines
projects.title: Philippine DOH study visit to KDCA ahead of creating a Philippine CDC
projects.summary: The Philippine health OIC visited KDCA in 2022 to learn from its model in preparation for establishing a Philippine Center for Disease Control and Prevention.

projects.institutes: Saudi Public Health Authority (Weqaya)
projects.title: China CDC – Saudi Public Health Authority leadership meeting on technical cooperation
projects.summary: The acting CEO of the Saudi Public Health Authority met China CDC's director in Beijing to select priority areas (immunization, emergency response, surveillance) under the China–Saudi health MoU and set up regular technical exchanges.
projects.note: Meeting 18 Sep 2026; no institute-level MoU signed yet.

projects.institutes: National Center for Communicable Diseases (NCCD) of Mongolia
projects.title: China CDC – Mongolia NCCD memorandum of understanding (2021, renewed 2026)
projects.summary: MoU first signed in December 2021 and renewed in September 2026 for a new five-year cycle, covering emerging infectious diseases, TB and HIV, workforce development, surveillance IT and emergency response, with plans for FETP and laboratory work.

projects.institutes: Sierra Leone Ministry of Health and Sanitation; Njala University; China CDC NIPD and ICDC; BGI Research
projects.title: Malaria molecular laboratory epidemiology network capacity project in Sierra Leone
projects.summary: Gates-funded pilot launched in January 2023 with Sierra Leone's Ministry of Health and Sanitation to build a malaria molecular epidemiology laboratory network. A follow-on 16-day laboratory training for Sierra Leonean staff was held in Beijing in 2026.
projects.note: Pilot kick-off: https://en.chinacdc.cn/news/latest/202302/t20230208_263677.html

projects.institutes: Communicable Diseases Agency Singapore (CDA, formerly iCDA)
projects.title: China CDC – Communicable Diseases Agency Singapore cooperation (MoU 2024, annual roundtables)
projects.summary: Following a 2024 memorandum, China CDC and Singapore's CDA hold annual technical roundtables and personnel exchanges on surveillance, preparedness, FETP, One Health, AMR and wastewater surveillance.
projects.note: Partner country Singapore (not in atlas). Second roundtable Sep 2026 in Singapore; third planned in China 2027.

projects.institutes: Thailand Department of Disease Control – Epidemiology Division / Thailand FETP
projects.title: China–Thailand FETP joint academic exchange
projects.summary: A Thai Department of Disease Control epidemiology delegation visited China CDC in February 2025 to discuss deeper FETP collaboration. In July 2026 the two FETPs held their first face-to-face modular joint academic exchange, meant as the basis for long-term cooperation.
projects.note: 2025 visit: https://en.chinacdc.cn/news/latest/202503/t20250326_305340.html

projects.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
projects.institutes: Center for Malariology, Parasitology and Entomology (CMPE), Laos; National Center for Parasitology, Entomology and Malaria Control (CNM), Cambodia
projects.title: China–Laos–Cambodia Accelerated Schistosomiasis Elimination Cooperation Project
projects.summary: South-South project funded by the Asian Cooperation Fund in which NIPD experts support Laos and Cambodia in eliminating Mekong schistosomiasis through field missions, surveillance and lab support.
projects.note: Missions to Laos Sep 2025 and Cambodia May 2026; see also https://en.chinacdc.cn/news/latest/202601/t20260106_314459.html

projects.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
projects.institutes: Partner institutions in the Lancang-Mekong subregion
projects.title: Lancang-Mekong Subregional Joint Laboratory Network for Tropical Disease Control
projects.summary: Network launched in 2025 at the RNAS+ annual meeting, with an MoU signed by NIPD to link tropical-disease laboratories of the five Mekong countries on shared objectives, target diseases and a work plan.

projects.actor: China CDC National Center for AIDS/STD Control and Prevention
projects.institutes: Sierra Leone Ministry of Health; National AIDS Control Programme; National AIDS Secretariat
projects.title: Pilot of integrated community HIV and viral hepatitis prevention in Sierra Leone
projects.summary: National Key R&D Program project in which NCAIDS pilots integrated community-based HIV and viral hepatitis prevention technologies and strategies in Sierra Leone, including field visits and technical exchanges.

projects.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
projects.institutes: Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Burkina Faso; Yalgado Ouedraogo University Hospital
projects.title: Burkina Faso INSP delegation exchange with China CDC NIPD
projects.summary: A Burkina Faso INSP delegation visited NIPD to exchange on parasitic and vector-borne disease control and explore future cooperation areas.

projects.institutes: Smorodintsev Research Institute of Influenza; National Research Center for Fundamental and Translational Medicine; other Russian institutes
projects.title: China–Russia Infectious Disease Symposium series
projects.summary: Annual bilateral symposium on infectious disease prevention and control, co-organised by China CDC and Russia's Smorodintsev Influenza Institute since 2018; the eighth edition was held in Saint Petersburg in 2025.

projects.institutes: Public Health England / UK Health Security Agency
projects.title: China CDC – PHE/UKHSA cooperation (MoUs 2015 and 2018)
projects.summary: China CDC signed MoUs with Public Health England in 2015 and 2018, covering exchanges on salt reduction, emergency response, lab safety, environmental health and vaccine evaluation. A 2022 heads-of-agency meeting with UKHSA continued the partnership.

projects.institutes: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA)
projects.title: China CDC – KDCA memorandum of understanding (renewed 2023)
projects.summary: MoU signed in Seoul in December 2023, continuing an earlier edition. It covers 11 areas, including communicable and non-communicable disease surveillance, prevention and control, and emergency preparedness, plus new chronic-disease projects.

projects.institutes: National Institute of Infectious Diseases (NIID), Japan
projects.title: China CDC – Japan NIID bilateral cooperation
projects.summary: At a 2023 leaders' meeting, the two institutes agreed to build on their information sharing, technical exchange and joint research by setting up a regular technical exchange mechanism and personnel training on influenza, immunization registries and polio surveillance.

projects.institutes: NIID / NCGM (Japan Institute for Health Security), Japan; KDCA, South Korea
projects.title: Japan–China–Korea Forum for Communicable Disease Control and Prevention
projects.summary: Trilateral annual forum and joint symposium of the three countries' national disease control institutes, held in rotation. The 18th edition (Tokyo, 2024) covered post-COVID epidemiology, climate and health, and hepatitis/STIs.
projects.note: 18 editions by 2024.

projects.institutes: National Scientific Center for Especially Dangerous Infections (NSCEDI), Kazakhstan
projects.title: China–Kazakhstan exchange on plague and zoonotic disease control
projects.summary: Kazakhstan's NSCEDI delegation visited China CDC and Xinjiang in 2023 to exchange on surveillance of plague, anthrax, tularemia and brucellosis. The visit built on Belt and Road plague meetings held since 2018.

projects.institutes: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
projects.title: China CDC – ECDC technical exchange on public health workforce training
projects.summary: An online exchange in January 2024 on EPIET/EUPHEM and China's CFETP and public health training, with intent to keep sharing information on workforce development.

projects.institutes: Federal Service for Surveillance on Consumer Rights Protection and Human Wellbeing (Rospotrebnadzor)
projects.title: China CDC – Rospotrebnadzor cooperation memorandum
projects.summary: Cooperation memorandum signed in 2020 covering infectious disease research, prevention and COVID-19 experience sharing. The heads of both agencies met in Beijing in 2024 to plan further exchanges.

projects.institutes: Russian Research Anti-Plague Institute 'Microbe'; National Center for Zoonotic Disease (Mongolia); National Scientific Center for Especially Dangerous Infections (Kazakhstan)
projects.title: Quadrilateral plague prevention and control cooperation (China–Russia–Mongolia–Kazakhstan)
projects.summary: China CDC hosted a 2021 webinar with plague institutes from Russia, Mongolia and Kazakhstan to share plague control technologies and work toward a joint cross-border plague control mechanism.

projects.institutes: Plague and public health experts from SCO member and observer states; Wu Lien-Teh Foundation
projects.title: Seminar on Plague Prevention and Control in SCO Countries
projects.summary: A 2025 Beijing seminar, followed by a Xinjiang–Central Asia technical exchange, to advance technical collaboration and joint plague control mechanisms among SCO countries.

projects.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
projects.institutes: Zimbabwe National Public Health Institute (ZNPHI); Ministry of Health and Child Care
projects.title: China–Zimbabwe schistosomiasis elimination project and National Center for International Research on Tropical Diseases
projects.summary: China-funded schistosomiasis elimination pilot in Shamva district. In 2023 NIPD and its Zimbabwean partner signed an MoU and opened a China–Zimbabwe tropical disease research centre, NIPD's sixth overseas centre.

projects.institutes: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (US CDC) and its China Program
projects.title: China CDC – US CDC cooperation and virtual technical exchange teleconference series
projects.summary: Long-standing partnership that includes a technical teleconference series running since 2020 (34th session in 2025), annual heads-of-agency meetings, and joint training such as the TB infection-control educator course.
projects.note: See also https://en.chinacdc.cn/news/latest/202503/t20250326_305342.html and TB training https://en.chinacdc.cn/news/latest/202401/t20240124_272249.html

projects.institutes: National health authorities of ASEAN member states; ASEAN Secretariat; Malaysia NIH Biobank; Singapore public health laboratory
projects.title: China CDC – ASEAN (Plus Three) public health emergency tabletop exercises
projects.summary: A series of online workshops and tabletop exercises for ASEAN health authorities: health emergency response under ASEAN+3 (2021), IT-supported outbreak investigation (2022), and preservation and use of pathogen resources (2025).
projects.note: Singapore also participated (not in atlas). 2021: https://en.chinacdc.cn/news/latest/202201/t20220119_256380.html ; 2025: https://en.chinacdc.cn/news/latest/202601/t20260106_314447.html

projects.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
projects.institutes: Ifakara Health Institute; National Malaria Control Programme (Tanzania); UK DFID
projects.title: China–UK–Tanzania Pilot Project on Malaria Control
projects.summary: A roughly three-year pilot under the DFID-backed China–UK Global Health Support Programme in which NIPD and Ifakara Health Institute applied a paired 'learning by doing' malaria control approach in Tanzania. It was followed by a Gates-funded China–Tanzania demonstration project (2019–2023).

projects.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
projects.institutes: National malaria programmes of partner countries; Chinese universities and provincial CDCs
projects.title: Institutional-based Network of China–Africa Cooperation on Malaria Elimination (INCAM)
projects.summary: NIPD-hosted network linking Chinese and African institutions on malaria elimination. Its 6th annual meeting (Changsha, 2025) brought together Tanzania, Zambia, Senegal and The Gambia, with WHO and the Gates Foundation.

projects.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
projects.institutes: University of Yaoundé; Theodor Bilharz Research Institute (Egypt); African schistosomiasis programmes
projects.title: Institution-Based Network on China–Africa Cooperation for Schistosomiasis Elimination
projects.summary: Network of Chinese and African institutions working on schistosomiasis elimination, hosted by NIPD. Its 7th annual meeting was held in Haikou in 2022.

projects.institutes: Myanmar Ministry of Health; National Center for Diseases Control and Medical Training Center; National Malaria Control Program
projects.title: China–Myanmar workshop on malaria elimination and infectious disease control
projects.summary: Annual bilateral workshop held since 2014, alternating between China and Myanmar, on malaria elimination in the border area and wider infectious disease control. The 8th edition was in Nay Pyi Taw in 2024.

projects.institutes: Myanmar health authorities (unnamed); Yunnan CDC
projects.title: China Public Health Team deployment to Myanmar after the 2025 earthquake
projects.summary: China CDC experts and Yunnan CDC formed a public health team that carried out risk assessment, water testing, vector surveillance, disinfection and vaccination guidance, and trained local staff after the 7.9-magnitude earthquake.

projects.institutes: Africa CDC; WHO; Uganda Incident Management Support Team; DRC health authorities
projects.title: China CDC Ebola response expert deployments to Uganda and DRC (2026)
projects.summary: At the invitation of Africa CDC and WHO, China CDC sent successive expert teams in 2026 to support Ebola surveillance, laboratory capacity and infection control in Uganda and the DRC.
projects.note: DRC: https://en.chinacdc.cn/news/latest/202608/t20260821_1839097.html

projects.institutes: National University of Singapore – Saw Swee Hock School of Public Health
projects.title: China CDC – NUS Saw Swee Hock School of Public Health cooperation MoU
projects.summary: MoU signed in Singapore in September 2026 on AMR surveillance, infectious disease modelling and forecasting, wastewater surveillance, and joint training of professionals and graduate students.
projects.note: Partner country Singapore (not in atlas).

projects.institutes: Fondation Mérieux
projects.title: China CDC – Fondation Mérieux partnership
projects.summary: A partnership of more than 20 years covering three completed rounds of TB control projects, emerging infectious diseases, an international Ebola seminar, and the Mérieux Youth Scholarship.

projects.actor: China CDC National Institute for Occupational Health and Poison Control
projects.institutes: Ministry of Health of Mongolia
projects.title: China–Mongolia occupational health exchange
projects.summary: A Mongolian Ministry of Health delegation visited NIOHP in January 2025. Both sides agreed to strengthen occupational disease regulation and raise occupational health service standards.

projects.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
projects.institutes: Swiss Tropical and Public Health Institute (Swiss TPH)
projects.title: NIPD – Swiss TPH strategic partnership on tropical diseases
projects.summary: A long-standing partnership on tropical disease research, control and training. A 2025 Swiss TPH leadership visit to NIPD reaffirmed cooperation on talent development and international research.

projects.institutes: IANPHI; Africa CDC; China CDC; Robert Koch Institute; Cuban NPHI; 20+ IANPHI members
projects.title: First Conference of G20 National Public Health Institutes (Rio de Janeiro, 2024)
projects.summary: Under Brazil's G20 presidency, Fiocruz, IANPHI and Africa CDC convened NPHI leaders on emergency preparedness, climate and health, equity and resilient health systems.

projects.institutes: BRICS TB research network partners
projects.title: BRICS TB Research Network meetings
projects.summary: China CDC's TB centre hosted the 11th BRICS tuberculosis research meeting online in 2022, where 34 BRICS scholars and officials discussed mitigating COVID-19's impact on TB.

projects.institutes: Myanmar National Center for Disease Control (Myanmar CDC); Myanmar Ministry of Health
projects.title: China CDC technical support for Myanmar CDC development
projects.summary: During a 2023 visit by Myanmar's deputy health minister, China CDC offered to share experience and give technical support for building and running Myanmar's national CDC. Both sides proposed cooperation on malaria, HIV, TB and dengue, plus expert exchanges.

projects.institutes: National Center for Parasitology, Entomology and Malaria Control (CNM), Cambodia
projects.title: China CDC – Cambodia CNM technical exchange on dengue emergency response
projects.summary: A Cambodian CNM delegation visited China CDC in December 2023 to learn from China's dengue surveillance and emergency management and to improve Cambodia's dengue response plan.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health of Honduras (Vector-Borne Disease Programme); GX Foundation
projects.title: China CDC – Honduras exchange on vector-borne disease control
projects.summary: A Honduran Ministry of Health delegation visited China CDC in January 2025 to explore cooperation on vector-borne disease control and emergency response capacity.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Public Health of Afghanistan
projects.title: Afghanistan Minister of Public Health visit to China CDC
projects.summary: Afghanistan's Minister of Public Health visited China CDC in December 2024 for talks on health emergency management and infectious disease surveillance and testing, including the National Influenza Center and mobile laboratory.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health and Sanitation of Sierra Leone; WHO
projects.title: Support for Sierra Leone's first National Viral Hepatitis Strategic Plan
projects.summary: China CDC worked with Sierra Leone's Ministry of Health and Sanitation and WHO to draft the country's first national viral hepatitis strategic plan, launched in December 2023.

projects.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
projects.institutes: Swiss Tropical and Public Health Institute; WHO; regional NTD/malaria networks
projects.title: Symposium on Surveillance-Response Systems Leading to Tropical Disease Elimination
projects.summary: Recurring international symposium co-organised by NIPD and Swiss TPH on surveillance-response systems for eliminating tropical diseases. The 2026 Shanghai edition also hosted annual meetings of China–Africa and Asian schistosomiasis, malaria and echinococcosis networks.
projects.note: 6th edition co-organised in 2022: https://en.chinacdc.cn/news/latest/202207/t20220701_259932.html (listing only)

projects.actor: China CDC National Center for AIDS/STD Control and Prevention
projects.institutes: UNAIDS China Office; African Union; HIV programme managers from 16 countries
projects.title: South-South Cooperation Technical Exchange Workshop on HIV/AIDS Prevention and Control
projects.summary: Annual workshop run by NCAIDS since 2017, with UNAIDS support, in which HIV programme managers from developing countries study China's HIV prevention and control practice in Beijing and Kunming.
projects.note: Participating countries (16) not named on the page.

projects.actor: Jordan National Epidemiology and Infectious Diseases Center (NEIDC / Jordan CDC)
projects.institutes: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
projects.title: Jordan NEIDC – US CDC memorandum of understanding
projects.summary: MoU signed in 2023 during a Jordanian NEIDC delegation visit to US CDC, aimed at strengthening Jordan's public health infrastructure and response plans for epidemics and other health threats.

projects.actor: Saudi Center for Disease Prevention and Control (Weqaya)
projects.institutes: Public Health Agency of Sweden (Folkhälsomyndigheten)
projects.title: Saudi CDC – Public Health Agency of Sweden cooperation agreement
projects.summary: A 2019 agreement covering workforce and organisational development, institutional strategy, specialised microbiology laboratories, health economics, communicable and non-communicable disease control, and healthy lifestyles.
projects.note: Saudi CDC later became the Public Health Authority (Weqaya).

projects.actor: Korea Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (KCDC)
projects.institutes: Saudi Ministry of Health
projects.title: Korea–Saudi framework of cooperation, including advice on establishing a Saudi disease control centre
projects.summary: After MERS, South Korea's health ministry and KCDC agreed in 2016 to advise Saudi Arabia on setting up a CDC, train Saudi health staff, and share information on emerging infections such as MERS and Zika.

projects.actor: Gulf Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (Gulf CDC)
projects.institutes: UK Health Security Agency
projects.title: Gulf CDC – UKHSA partnership agreement
projects.summary: Agreement signed in February 2024 to share public health knowledge and best practice and to strengthen health surveillance and epidemic response across GCC states.
projects.note: Gulf CDC is a GCC regional body; seat country used as actorCountry.

projects.institutes: Salidat Kairbekova National Research Center for Health Development
projects.title: TÜSEB – Kazakhstan National Research Center for Health Development MoU
projects.summary: MoU signed in Ankara in 2025 for cooperation on health research, biotechnology, drug development, healthcare quality and accreditation, telemedicine and workforce capacity building.

projects.institutes: Abu Dhabi Public Health Centre (ADPHC)
projects.title: Institut Pasteur – Abu Dhabi Public Health Centre training and education agreement
projects.summary: A specific agreement signed in January 2023 under an earlier MoU. It provides epidemiology and public health courses, research training in Pasteur units, and a regional training hub in Abu Dhabi to build ADPHC expertise.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Public Health, Qatar (Public Health Department)
projects.title: PHE – Qatar Ministry of Public Health memorandum of understanding
projects.summary: An MoU signed in 2019 at the first Qatar Public Health Conference to strengthen bilateral cooperation on public health communication, exchange of expertise, academic activities and research.

projects.institutes: Service for Sanitary and Epidemiological Wellbeing and Public Health (SSEWPH) and National Reference Laboratory; Ministry of Health; Emergency Operation Center
projects.title: CDC in Uzbekistan: 20 years of collaboration with the sanitary-epidemiological service
projects.summary: Since 2003 US CDC has worked with Uzbekistan's sanitary-epidemiological and public health service on workforce training, border health, laboratory capacity, emergency operations and COVID-19 PCR testing.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health of Kyrgyzstan
projects.title: Russia–Kyrgyzstan biosecurity cooperation: mobile laboratories for dangerous infections
projects.summary: As part of long-standing cooperation, Russia handed Kyrgyzstan a mobile PCR/ELISA lab and an inflatable field lab in 2025, adding to earlier mobile units. Russian and Kyrgyz mobile labs have jointly examined plague foci.
projects.note: Rospotrebnadzor head Anna Popova attended the 2025 handover; the page names the Russian Federation as donor.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health and Social Protection of the Population of Tajikistan
projects.title: Rospotrebnadzor 'Microbe' institute sanitary-epidemiological assessment mission to Tajikistan
projects.summary: In 2021 experts from Rospotrebnadzor's Microbe anti-plague institute visited Tajik laboratories and medical institutions to assess the sanitary-epidemiological situation, following the Tajik–Russian intergovernmental commission.

projects.actor: Jordan National Center for Disease Control and Prevention (JCDC)
projects.institutes: KfW Development Bank
projects.title: German KfW financing (up to EUR 39 million) to build Jordan CDC
projects.summary: A 2023 financing agreement under which KfW funds a permanent building, laboratories, equipment and staff training for Jordan's new national CDC to strengthen epidemic and pandemic preparedness.

projects.institutes: National Center of Public Health Laboratories, Ministry of Public Health and Population, Yemen
projects.title: JCDC – Yemen public health laboratories cooperation talks
projects.summary: A Yemeni national public health laboratory delegation met JCDC in 2024 to discuss drawing on Jordanian expertise in surveillance and laboratories.

projects.actor: National Scientific Center of Especially Dangerous Infections (Kazakhstan)
projects.institutes: Republican Center for Prevention of Especially Dangerous Infections (Kyrgyzstan)
projects.title: Kazakhstan–Kyrgyzstan MoU on biological security in Central Asia
projects.summary: A 2024 MoU between the two countries' especially-dangerous-infection centres on joint biosafety research, monitoring and information exchange on dangerous infections, and specialist training.

projects.institutes: Tashkent Medical Academy
projects.title: US CDC – Tashkent Medical Academy memorandum
projects.summary: A 2019 memorandum to expand medical education and research ties, develop internationally aligned curricula, and strengthen research capacity at Tashkent Medical Academy.

projects.institutes: Iraq Centers for Disease Control and Prevention; Central Public Health Laboratory; veterinary laboratory
projects.title: Strengthening brucellosis surveillance, diagnosis and control in Iraq
projects.summary: An EMPHNET-supported project with Iraq CDC and the Central Public Health Laboratory to set up a tiered brucellosis diagnostic workflow (Rose Bengal, ELISA, RT-PCR) and identify circulating Brucella species in four provinces.

projects.institutes: Iraq Ministry of Health; Iraq Center for Disease Control and Prevention
projects.title: Multi-centre hospital-based surveillance of meningococcal meningitis in Iraq
projects.summary: GHD|EMPHNET supports Iraq's Ministry of Health and Iraq CDC in hospital-based surveillance of invasive meningococcal disease across 18 hospitals in four provinces, building laboratory capacity.

projects.institutes: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
projects.title: ECDC–US CDC memorandum of understanding
projects.summary: One of ECDC's first international MoUs, signed in 2007 with the US CDC to cooperate on communicable disease prevention and control.

projects.institutes: Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC)
projects.title: ECDC–PHAC memorandum of understanding
projects.summary: MoU signed in 2007 between ECDC and the Public Health Agency of Canada on cooperation in communicable disease control.

projects.institutes: Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC)
projects.title: ECDC–China CDC memorandum of understanding
projects.summary: Since a 2007 MoU, ECDC and China CDC have cooperated on epidemic intelligence and response, syndromic surveillance for mass gatherings, preparedness and AMR.

projects.institutes: Israel Center for Disease Control (ICDC)
projects.title: ECDC–Israel CDC administrative agreement
projects.summary: Administrative agreement concluded in 2012 between ECDC and Israel's Center for Disease Control.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health of Mexico
projects.title: ECDC–Mexico Ministry of Health memorandum of understanding
projects.summary: MoU signed in June 2021 between ECDC and Mexico's Ministry of Health on public health cooperation.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare of Japan; Japan Institute for Health Security (JIHS); National Institute of Infectious Diseases (NIID)
projects.title: ECDC–Japan memorandum of cooperation
projects.summary: Memorandum of cooperation signed in Tokyo in October 2024 covering epidemic intelligence, AMR, vaccines, risk communication, training and preparedness, formalising earlier exchanges with NIID.

projects.institutes: National public health institutes and ministries of health of EU Enlargement and Neighbourhood countries
projects.title: EU Initiative on Health Security (2020–2025)
projects.summary: DG NEAR-funded €9 million programme through which ECDC built epidemic intelligence, risk assessment, preparedness and field-epidemiology (MediPIET) capacity in 21 neighbourhood and enlargement countries and integrated them into ECDC networks.

projects.institutes: Gulf Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (Gulf CDC); Gulf Health Council
projects.title: ECDC–Gulf CDC collaboration
projects.summary: Collaboration since 2022 on EOC development and knowledge management; a June 2025 visit to ECDC agreed to deepen work on preparedness, surveillance and epidemic intelligence and to formalise the partnership.
projects.note: Gulf CDC is the GCC regional CDC, seated in Riyadh.

projects.institutes: Gulf Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (Gulf CDC)
projects.title: UKHSA–Gulf CDC partnership agreement
projects.summary: Agreement signed in February 2024 to exchange knowledge and best practice in public health management and strengthen disease monitoring and epidemic response across the GCC region.
projects.note: Gulf CDC is the GCC regional CDC, seated in Riyadh; covers Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE.

projects.institutes: Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC)
projects.title: PHE–China CDC memoranda of understanding
