projects.summary: AFD-funded project (2021–2024) with Haiti's national public health laboratory and GHESKIO to strengthen COVID-19 diagnosis and surveillance.

projects.actor: US CDC (WHO Collaborating Centre for Influenza)
projects.institutes: PAHO/WHO; InDRE (host); National Influenza Centres of participating countries
projects.title: CDC–PAHO regional course on influenza molecular diagnostics hosted by InDRE
projects.summary: International training in August 2018 at Mexico's InDRE for National Influenza Centres and laboratories of 11 countries on PCR-based influenza detection, strengthening the regional GISRS network.

projects.institutes: Ministerio de Salud del Perú; Seguro Integral de Salud (SIS); APCI
projects.title: KOICA–Peru project on SIS digitalisation and telemedicine
projects.summary: US$7 million Korean grant agreed in 2021 to digitise Peru's public health insurance management and build the 'Tele atiendo' telemedicine platform, piloted in 300 public health centres, to run until 2026.

projects.institutes: Japan Institute for Health Security (JIHS)
projects.title: Africa CDC – JIHS Memorandum of Cooperation
projects.summary: Cooperation memorandum signed in March 2026 between Africa CDC and Japan's new national health security institute, covering surveillance and early warning, laboratory and research capacity, workforce training and exchanges, and One Health work on zoonoses and AMR. Activities are to be set out in a joint action plan.
projects.note: Signed 5 March 2026 (simultaneously in Addis Ababa and Tokyo); no term stated. The page also mentions climate-resilient approaches.

projects.institutes: WHO; China CDC Centre for Tuberculosis Control and Prevention; National Disease Control and Prevention Administration
projects.title: WHO Collaborating Centre for Innovation and Global Cooperation for TB Elimination (China CDC)
projects.summary: WHO collaborating centre hosted by China CDC, inaugurated in Beijing in August 2026, intended to help other countries strengthen tuberculosis prevention and control, with a first set of 13 TB practical training bases.
projects.note: Ceremony 28 Aug 2026; partner countries and designation term not stated.

projects.institutes: Universidade Lusófona – Centro Universitário Lisboa (COFAC); Fiocruz Farmanguinhos
projects.title: Fiocruz – Universidade Lusófona memorandum of understanding
projects.summary: MoU signed in March 2026 to build cooperation in health-science teaching, research and technology development, laying a basis for joint projects and academic exchange.
projects.note: Published 31 March 2026; no duration stated.

projects.actor: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST)
projects.institutes: University of Ghana; Université Cheikh Anta Diop (Senegal); Wellcome; Ghana Ministry of Health
projects.title: Pan-African Climate and Health Science and Policy Consortia (West and Southern Africa)
projects.summary: Two Wellcome-funded consortia (about £40 million) launched in Accra in July 2026 to research climate impacts on food systems, malaria and other vector-borne and non-communicable diseases and feed results into policy, including a climate-linked outbreak dashboard.
projects.note: No national public health institute named; ministries of health of Ghana and Senegal took part. West African arm also reported by 3News (25 Aug 2026).

projects.institutes: US Defense Threat Reduction Agency (DTRA)
projects.title: Regional Diagnostic Demonstration Center (training centre) at NICD
projects.summary: A training centre at NICD in Johannesburg, renovated with DTRA, runs biorisk management and outbreak response courses for South African and other regional participants.

projects.actor: National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), India
projects.institutes: WHO SEARO
projects.title: Regional Field Epidemiology Training Programme for South-East Asia at NCDC India
projects.summary: NCDC, a WHO collaborating centre for epidemiology and training, runs a regional field epidemiology course for health staff from WHO South-East Asia Region countries.

projects.institutes: Centre for Research and Training in Public Health (CFRSP), University of Lomé
projects.title: PRISME Togo – international research platform on global health and environment (Lomé)
projects.summary: ANRS MIE is setting up a research platform in Lomé with the University of Lomé's public health research centre, to structure research, training and scholarships on health and environment in West Africa; a framework agreement was planned for early 2026.

projects.actor: Institute of Tropical Medicine Pedro Kourí (IPK)
projects.institutes: PAHO/WHO Collaborating Center for the Study of Dengue and its Control (at IPK); Cuban Ministry of Public Health
projects.title: IPK International Course on Dengue, Oropouche and other Emerging Arboviruses
projects.summary: IPK, a PAHO/WHO collaborating centre for dengue, runs a recurring international course for health professionals from abroad; the 19th edition moved from August 2026 to 2027.

projects.actor: National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania
projects.institutes: University of Copenhagen; Rigshospitalet; LSHTM; Cornell University
projects.title: LINK-CVD – infections, malnutrition and early cardiovascular disease (NIMR Mwanza)
projects.summary: NIMR's Mwanza centre hosts a research collaboration with Danish, British and US partners on how infectious diseases and malnutrition relate to early-onset cardiovascular disease in sub-Saharan Africa.

projects.actor: Instituto Costarricense de Investigación y Enseñanza en Nutrición y Salud (INCIENSA)
projects.institutes: National Influenza Centre, Laboratorio Nacional de Vigilancia de la Salud (Honduras); PAHO
projects.title: INCIENSA training of Honduras' National Influenza Centre in antiviral resistance testing
projects.summary: Costa Rica's National Influenza Centre at INCIENSA trained the coordinator of Honduras' influenza centre in cell culture, virus isolation and a phenotypic oseltamivir-resistance assay.

projects.institutes: ORAS-CONHU (Andean Health Organization); IDB; national health institutes of Bolivia, Colombia and Ecuador
projects.title: Andean genomic surveillance exchange for El Niño-related infectious diseases (ORAS-CONHU)
projects.summary: Under an Andean Health Organization project with the IDB, Peru's INS agreed to share diagnostic and genomic-characterisation know-how with Bolivia and Ecuador ahead of El Niño, and the four national institutes planned a regional observatory.

projects.institutes: Mongolia Ministry of Health; National Center for Communicable Diseases; National Center for Public Health
projects.title: China CDC support for setting up a national CDC in Mongolia
projects.summary: After Mongolia's 2024 public health law created a national CDC, a Mongolian delegation studied China CDC's structure and China CDC pledged comprehensive support for establishing the new centre.

projects.institutes: Africa CDC
projects.title: Institut Pasteur d'Algérie as Africa CDC regional centre of excellence for biosafety and biosecurity (North Africa)
projects.summary: After an Africa CDC evaluation in early 2026, the institute was named North Africa's regional reference centre for biosafety and biosecurity and hosts regional containment-engineering courses for experts from several North African countries.

projects.actor: Health Service Executive (HSE) Global Health Programme
projects.institutes: Zambian College of Medicine and Surgery; Royal College of Physicians of Ireland (EQUALS Initiative)
projects.title: HSE–Zambia partnership on specialist training and medical equipment (EQUALS)
projects.summary: Ireland's HSE helped set up Zambia's postgraduate specialist training (college founded 2017), ships reusable equipment and trains biomedical engineers; the RCPI-backed EQUALS model was later extended to Uganda.

projects.actor: Health Service Executive (HSE) Global Health Programme
projects.institutes: University College Dublin (Ukraine Trauma Project); NGOs
projects.title: HSE support to Ukraine: emergency resuscitation training and equipment
projects.summary: The HSE Global Health Programme funds an emergency resuscitation training project with University College Dublin and sends medical equipment to Ukraine through NGOs.

projects.actor: Instituto de Diagnóstico y Referencia Epidemiológicos (InDRE)
projects.institutes: INLASA (La Paz); CENETROP (Santa Cruz); PAHO; WHO collaborating centres
projects.title: InDRE mission to strengthen quality and biorisk management at Bolivia's reference laboratories
projects.summary: Experts from Mexico's InDRE, with PAHO and WHO collaborating centres, assessed and trained Bolivia's INLASA and CENETROP on biosafety and quality management for influenza and emerging pathogens.

projects.institutes: WHO; Palestinian Ministry of Health; Norwegian Representative Office (funder)
projects.title: Establishing the Palestinian National Public Health Institute (WHO–Norway project)
projects.summary: A Norway-funded, WHO-managed project with NIPH and the Palestinian Ministry of Health laid the groundwork for a national public health institute in Ramallah (NOK 23 million).

projects.institutes: US CDC; WHO; IntraHealth International; AFENET; Ethiopian Public Health Institute (2019 benchmarking visit)
projects.title: Support for establishing South Sudan's National Public Health Institute
projects.summary: Africa CDC, US CDC and WHO backed South Sudan's NPHI legal framework (2019) and advocacy, US CDC funded a 2019 benchmarking visit to Ethiopia's EPHI, and partners support field epidemiology fellowships for the new institute.

projects.institutes: Albanian Ministry of Health
projects.title: ISS – Albanian Ministry of Health memorandum on public health cooperation
projects.summary: ISS agreed to give operational support to Albania on communicable and non-communicable diseases, environmental health, staff training and joint international research.

projects.institutes: WHO Libya; National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) Libya; National Center for Animal Health (NCAH); Libyan Ministry of Environment; funded by AICS
projects.title: Arboviral and zoonotic diseases in Libya (ISS–WHO, AICS-funded)
projects.summary: Two-year Italian-funded project run by ISS and WHO with Libya's NCDC and animal-health and environment authorities to strengthen One Health surveillance, early detection and laboratory diagnosis of arboviruses and zoonoses; ISS leads staff training.
projects.note: Signed June 2024 for two years; current status not verified.

projects.institutes: Instituto Nacional de Higiene Rafael Rangel (INHRR)
projects.title: Saint Petersburg Pasteur Institute – INHRR joint diagnostic research
projects.summary: Russian experts agreed a joint research plan with Venezuela's national hygiene institute in Caracas in June 2026, covering laboratory diagnosis of viral hepatitis, measles, rubella, parvovirus B19, diphtheria and pertussis with Russian test systems.
projects.note: Joint research stage reported for 18 June – 2 July 2026; follow-up not verified.

projects.institutes: National Institute of Public Health (NIPH) Cambodia; National Centre for Parasitology, Entomology and Malaria Control (CNM); NCHADS; Sihanouk Hospital Centre of Hope
projects.title: Research capacity of Cambodian national institutes (ITM FA4, 2018)
projects.summary: Belgian-funded ITM programme that built clinical, operational, entomological and health-systems research capacity at Cambodian national institutes including NIPH, covering malaria and vector control, HIV/syphilis MTCT elimination and health policy research.
projects.note: Project record covers 2018 only (part of the DGD FA4 framework).

projects.actor: SECID / Institute of Public Health, Albania (SEEHN)
projects.institutes: South East European Center for Surveillance and Control of Infectious Diseases (Tirana); South-eastern Europe Health Network (SEEHN); national public health institutes of the region; CORDS network; assisted by US CDC
projects.title: SECID – South East European Center for Surveillance and Control of Infectious Diseases
projects.summary: Regional centre set up in Tirana in 2013 under SEEHN, linked to Albania's Institute of Public Health, that supports national authorities across South-East Europe on influenza and respiratory-pathogen surveillance, pandemic preparedness and cross-border capacity building.
projects.note: Member list from hzjz.hr SECID page (project period 2013–2018). IPH North Macedonia met SECID on 9 Feb 2026 to continue cooperation (iph.mk/en/news/index/1707).

projects.actor: Technical University of Denmark (DTU) with Statens Serum Institut
projects.institutes: Statens Serum Institut; University of Copenhagen; Imperial College London; unnamed collaborators in Europe, Africa and Asia; funded by Novo Nordisk Foundation
projects.title: Global Pathogen Analysis Platform (GPAP)
projects.summary: AI and bioinformatics platform for One Health pathogen surveillance being built at DTU with SSI, Copenhagen and Imperial, to be developed and piloted with researchers and health authorities in low- and middle-income countries over six years.
projects.note: Announced in 2025 with up to DKK 200 million over six years; start date not stated.

projects.institutes: Technical University of Denmark (DTU, SeqAfrica coordinator); Fleming Fund (UK); AMR surveillance sentinel sites
projects.title: SeqAfrica – whole genome sequencing for AMR surveillance, sentinel site training at IPD
projects.summary: Institut Pasteur de Dakar trained sentinel-site staff in nanopore whole genome sequencing and bioinformatics for antimicrobial resistance surveillance, as part of the DTU-coordinated SeqAfrica project funded by the UK Fleming Fund.
projects.note: Training held 10–12 February 2025. The source does not name the other partner countries in SeqAfrica.

projects.actor: Department of Disease Control, Thailand (Division of Epidemiology / Thailand FETP)
projects.institutes: WHO Regional Office for South-East Asia; WHO Country Office Thailand
projects.title: Thailand FETP designated WHO Collaborating Centre for Field Epidemiology Training
projects.summary: The Division of Epidemiology, which runs Thailand's Field Epidemiology Training Program, became a WHO Collaborating Centre for field epidemiology training, to support outbreak detection and response capacity in the wider Asia-Pacific region.
projects.note: WHO news item published 4 February 2025. Serves the wider Asia-Pacific region; partner countries are not named.

projects.actor: Instituto de Salud Pública de Chile (ISP)
projects.institutes: Dirección Nacional de Vigilancia Sanitaria (DINAVISA), Paraguay
projects.title: ISP Chile – DINAVISA Paraguay technical cooperation agreement
projects.summary: Agreement for technical and scientific assistance: staff training, good regulatory practices for control and surveillance of medicines and medical devices, and stronger quality-control laboratories.
projects.note: Signed in Asunción (reported 23 August 2022); duration not stated.

projects.actor: Public Health Institute of Republika Srpska
projects.institutes: Institute of Public Health of Montenegro; Public Health Institute of Sisak-Moslavina County (Croatia)
projects.title: ERI-Health – public health preparedness for cross-border epidemics and emergencies
projects.summary: Interreg IPA cross-border project that upgraded outbreak diagnostics (COVID-19 PCR, zoonotic and vector-borne disease tests), trained health staff and set up quick information sharing between partners in the three countries.
projects.note: Interreg IPA CBC Croatia–Bosnia and Herzegovina–Montenegro 2014–2020; 15 January 2021 to 14 January 2023. The Croatian partner is a county institute, not HZJZ.
